newsitem.title: USA: Winstar to buy 47 licenses for $17 mln.
newsitem.headline: Winstar to buy 47 licenses for $17 mln.

text.p: Winstar Communications Inc said on Thursday that it has signed agreements to acquire 47 additional 38 GHz licenses and associated business operations for $17 million.
The company said it would pay with restricted WinStar common stock.

The licenses, which include 15 channels in the top 50 markets, are in addition to the company's existing 38 GHz licenses. The transactions are expected to close within the next year, subject to U.S. Federal Communications Commission approval, the company said.

After it completed these and other pending acquisitions, the company said its coverage would be about 180 million and its total channel pops -- the population coverage multiplied by number of channels -- would be about 650 million.
